name: Ava Lawrence
source:
Ava is described as being an 'intense' person, something that Main Character says makes sense for the captain of the cheer squad. She is popular, in-tuned to school gossip, and has the reputation of being a boy-crazy girl with a mean streak. She used to have a preconceived notion about how love is supposed to be: hard and unfulfilling. So when she dated her past boyfriends and felt that way, she did not think anything was wrong with her relationships. As a freshman, she daydreamed about finding the perfect boyfriend, going to the same college as him, and living happily ever after. 

As a senior, however, she feels lost. She would like a fresh start where her reputation would not precede her, and where she could find someone who is as crazy about her as she is about that person.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Best_Friend]Wiki[/url]]
